Parent checks incremental critical claims, conventions/units and counter-explanations; no redundant whole-book reread.
New derivations beyond reliable direct reconstruction receive Terra narrow audit.
New reusable findings recorded in knowledge; new sources archived with actual access/reading limits.
Coherent reader steps, chapter interfaces and defined notation; no personal experiments/results invented.
Python figure producer and paired SVG/PDF in Img when useful; no synthetic result passed as experiment.
All 39 sections and necessary appendix scope integrated, citations and references resolved, scientific boundaries represented, build and visual checks appropriate, explicit Git publication.
incomplete_criteria: Open questions, token usage or target page count do not define completion. Never mark native goal complete at an intermediate checkpoint.
